status: Shipped capability map; execution and validation limits are explicit.

status_definitions.bundled: The reusable procedure, agent routing, reference or repository tooling is present in the mapped files; this is not a claim of host activation or completed project execution.
status_definitions.project-configured execution (procedure: The reusable procedure and working record are present; actual application, provider, storage, browser or deployment execution uses project configuration and task authorization.

63 primary overviews: 52 complete, five prose without code blocks, six selected sections.
155 README introductions/headings; three repositories without a root README; two empty repositories.

focused_followup.observation: UI workflow instructions request browser evidence, responsive screenshots and accessibility checks. Source also overgeneralizes every-interaction full-suite execution and hard-coded counts; use changed-flow evidence and actual results instead. No app source or tests executed.

limits: All 494 returned account repositories have metadata records; inventory and overview coverage are not full source audits.
Account source sampling covers 23 repositories, plus selected-source reviews of the two AI targets; the running-agent README/AGENTS follow-up is separately recorded.
Enumeration is the unique population returned by the connector; total_count and incomplete_results were unavailable. Private, hidden, deleted and newly unindexed repositories are outside coverage.
Cross-account metadata and file retrievals are not an atomic snapshot.
Many hub demos and large/binary assets were not read. Made With ML CSVs were inspected by header and one row, and notebooks by selected cells, not a complete data/notebook audit.
Source inspection did not execute upstream code, install upstream dependencies, verify upstream CI or deploy a service.
Commit-linked URLs identify revisions where available; default-branch URLs are mutable. Recorded blob hashes identify file content and are not commit hashes.

role_bundling: Architect owns material planning; engineer owns coordination. A separate planner profile would duplicate those responsibilities.
Context maintenance covers documentation and handoffs; discovery plus maintained setup handles onboarding. Separate prose-only roles would multiply sources of truth.
Debugging and tool integration share resilience/observability references; test design owns persistence. These are boundary-specific procedures, not independent always-running services.
AI engineer routes evaluation, retrieval, data, model and tool work to focused skills. Model/prompt identity and serving checks use those contracts plus release delivery.

Researcher, test engineer, AI engineer and release engineer provide distinct work products, while existing evaluator, reviewer, debugger, security reviewer, architect and engineer responsibilities remain available.
Performance retains a dedicated measurement procedure because comparable workload and metric semantics require explicit treatment; multiple agent names or agreement are not acceptance evidence.

bounded_design_challenges.challenge: Does the expansion support a concrete request or merely increase the number of profiles?
bounded_design_challenges.disposition: Map all 32 families to a working procedure/artifact, route by the actual task, and preserve direct execution when no custom agent is selected.

bounded_design_challenges.challenge: Could overview inventory, a mutable source link or a static pass be mistaken for verified implementation behavior?
bounded_design_challenges.disposition: Retain source tiers/revisions, independent oracles and explicit unrun/inconclusive states; keep upstream inspection separate from local and host execution.

bounded_design_challenges.challenge: Would a neutral template silently select providers, publish artifacts or require unavailable infrastructure?
bounded_design_challenges.disposition: Ship executable local metadata/report tools and reusable integration procedures; actual external execution uses the adopted project and existing authorization.

bounded_design_challenges.challenge: Would separate agents for every family duplicate instructions and drift?
bounded_design_challenges.disposition: Use 21 canonical skills and 10 agent profiles, merge overlapping roles, link focused references and generate the catalog from real metadata.

bounded_design_challenges.challenge: Could parallel file edits, stale output identity or a failing dependency be hidden by a successful summary?
bounded_design_challenges.disposition: Give shared files one writer, inspect actual handoffs, bind checks to the combined artifact and require machine-detectable failure paths.

challenge_stop_rule: Close a challenge by revising the plan, supplying acceptance evidence or recording a bounded unresolved limit. Reopen only for a new finding, changed requirement or failed gate; no indefinite debate or mandatory multi-agent chain.

families.family: Evidence-first research and coverage accounting
families.shipped_behavior: Record coverage, revisions, observations, inference and adoption decisions.
families.execution_boundary: Source access and execution evidence must be established for each new investigation.
families.excluded_implementation: No claim that overview inventory equals every-line audit; no automatic execution of external repositories

families.family: Acceptance-led planning and multiple independent challenges
families.shipped_behavior: Compare feasible alternatives, challenge concrete failures, resolve findings and stop at sufficient acceptance evidence.
families.execution_boundary: Material planning uses the actual project contracts; routine edits do not acquire a fixed review chain.
families.excluded_implementation: No indefinite debate or fixed approval chain for trivial edits

families.family: Bounded specialist delegation and independent synthesis
families.shipped_behavior: Partition independent work, assign one writer per shared area and integrate evidence-bearing handoffs.
families.execution_boundary: A supported running host provides delegation; the procedure also works locally when custom agents cannot be invoked.
families.excluded_implementation: No paid-model council prerequisite or consensus-as-truth

families.family: Living project context and instruction drift repair
families.shipped_behavior: Refresh facts and handoffs from current commands, code and accepted decisions; preserve unfinished work.
families.execution_boundary: Do not promote unverified preferences or temporary observations into policy.
families.excluded_implementation: Do not install detected MCP services automatically or overwrite existing policy

families.family: Repository-aware environment setup
families.shipped_behavior: Combine repository discovery, maintained setup commands and the Copilot setup workflow.
families.execution_boundary: The workflow prepares repository tools; application runtime, devcontainer choices and actual cloud-agent execution depend on the adopted project.
families.excluded_implementation: Devcontainer image/runtime selection remains conditional on project; no global Git settings

families.family: Monorepo, collection, docs, notebook and package classification
families.shipped_behavior: Classify applications, example collections, workspaces, notebooks, courses, generators and documentation from concrete evidence.
families.execution_boundary: Repository shape may overlap; an index or neighboring example does not establish the active runtime.
families.excluded_implementation: No rigid classifier-score assumptions; a directory collection is not automatically a workspace

families.family: Independent behavior oracles and test design
families.shipped_behavior: Select regression, boundary and consumer cases with independent expectations and nonzero failure propagation.
families.execution_boundary: The project supplies its real harness and supported-environment runs.
families.excluded_implementation: No mandatory PyTorch or language test framework; avoid implementation-mirroring tests

families.family: Real host, process, browser and transport boundary tests
families.shipped_behavior: Record process, remote workspace, host, transport and consumer identity; distinguish simulated from actual execution.
families.execution_boundary: Static metadata, source inspection and local substitutes do not prove actual host or integration behavior.
families.excluded_implementation: No automatic assertion that static metadata validation proves host invocation

families.family: Hypothesis-led failure reproduction and repair
families.shipped_behavior: Trace the first causal error, compare hypotheses and choose the smallest discriminating experiment.
families.execution_boundary: A confirmed repair requires the original reproduction and relevant recovery evidence.
families.excluded_implementation: Do not weaken tests, catch-all errors or reset user work to make symptoms disappear

families.family: Machine-readable evaluation contracts and honest outcomes
families.shipped_behavior: Define versioned cases, outcomes and acceptance; provide an offline JSON report gate and negative-case tests.
families.execution_boundary: The report checker is executable locally; it does not run a model, authenticate evidence or establish label quality.
families.excluded_implementation: No universal numeric pass threshold or provider-error-to-quality conversion

families.family: Bounded reproducible experimentation and optimization
families.shipped_behavior: Freeze a baseline and evaluator, bound attempts and resources, preserve rejected trials and retain only verified improvements.
families.execution_boundary: Actual runners, datasets and paid resources use project configuration and existing task authorization.
families.excluded_implementation: No infinite agent loop, shared-branch resets or holdout optimization

families.family: Retrieval engineering and evidence-grounded answers
families.shipped_behavior: Trace ingestion, identities, access filtering, retrieval, citations, updates and answer support.
families.execution_boundary: The project chooses the corpus, index and providers; no ready-made benchmark or service is installed.
families.excluded_implementation: No universal chunk size, embedding model, vector database or cloud dependency

families.family: Data validation, splits and lineage
families.shipped_behavior: Record schema, provenance, transformations, partitions, rejected records and consumer impact.
families.execution_boundary: Real data checks use approved project data and tooling; repository licenses do not settle dataset or model rights.
families.excluded_implementation: Dataset library, model weights and sample personal data are project choices

families.family: Model, prompt, evaluator and serving consistency
families.shipped_behavior: Tie effective model, prompt, evaluator, data transformation and delivered artifact identities to the comparison and consumer contract.
families.execution_boundary: Serving and preprocessing compatibility must be checked through the selected project pipeline; no model framework or hardware is bundled.
families.excluded_implementation: No framework adoption or training hardware implied

families.family: Tool schemas, MCP protocol and integration validation
families.shipped_behavior: Define schemas, identity, side effects, machine-distinguishable failures, retries and transport checks, including protocol-only stdio stdout.
families.execution_boundary: Actual SDK/protocol versions, credentials and host exchanges come from the project and current official documentation.
families.excluded_implementation: No auto-installed server, wildcard credentials or local maintainer paths; current official protocol controls syntax

families.family: Actual provider and external data-flow accounting
families.shipped_behavior: Record effective inference, embedding, memory, search, evaluation and telemetry destinations separately.
families.execution_boundary: A README label or one configured model does not establish the deployed data flow.
families.excluded_implementation: Do not label a service local/private from README or a single configured model

families.family: Trust boundaries, secrets and denied-operation validation
families.shipped_behavior: Trace concrete trust boundaries and verify denied operations without unintended state changes.
families.execution_boundary: Instructions and hooks do not enforce an operating-system sandbox or grant access.
families.excluded_implementation: Hooks/instructions are not an OS sandbox; no permission bypass defaults

families.family: Timeout, retry, idempotency, cache and lifecycle failure contracts
families.shipped_behavior: Select bounded retry, idempotency, cancellation, partial-result, recovery and cache/lifecycle checks for the actual failing boundary.
families.execution_boundary: Recovery policy and actual runtime failure tests depend on the operation; no outage or chaos infrastructure is provisioned.
families.excluded_implementation: No chaos infrastructure or remote outage testing required for the template

families.family: Structured outcomes, correlation and diagnostic evidence
families.shipped_behavior: Correlate operations and artifact versions; preserve useful redacted diagnostics and separate errors from quality and resource measurements.
families.execution_boundary: The project supplies telemetry and evidence locations; raw protected payload logging is not a default.
families.excluded_implementation: No hosted telemetry default or logging prompt/user content by default

families.family: Validate generated and distributed consumer artifacts
families.shipped_behavior: Inspect distributed contents, bind artifact identity and verify the built output through its consumer.
families.execution_boundary: Packaging format, runtime and smoke commands follow the adopted project; source-only success does not verify the package.
families.excluded_implementation: No VSIX-specific packaging or universal size threshold

families.family: Verification-bound release and rollback
families.shipped_behavior: Promote the evaluated artifact, retain recovery identity and report prepared, published, deployed and healthy separately.
families.execution_boundary: Publication/deployment and remote smoke checks require the existing task scope and configured target.
families.excluded_implementation: No automatic deployment or registry/cloud credentials just to enable the skill

families.family: Dependency/runtime upgrade and compatibility maintenance
families.shipped_behavior: Assess release notes, compatibility, resolved dependencies, consumer behavior and rollback for focused upgrades.
families.execution_boundary: New versions and supported lanes need current evidence; no blanket major-upgrade policy is imposed.
families.excluded_implementation: No mass major upgrades or latest-version policy without compatibility evidence

families.family: Intentional CI matrix and machine-detectable gates
families.shipped_behavior: Wire static metadata/catalog checks and offline report-tool tests into machine-detectable gates while retaining the Repository checks contract.
families.execution_boundary: Bundled workflow configuration is distinct from an observed GitHub run; application CI is configured separately.
families.excluded_implementation: No tests that print failure and exit zero; no optionalizing required tests

families.family: Developer documentation and interface maintenance
families.shipped_behavior: Keep source, command, decision and documentation relationships aligned in the existing context workflow.
families.execution_boundary: No separate documentation agent or site generator is required to maintain the same source of truth.
families.excluded_implementation: No boilerplate docs site generator or social publishing workflow

families.family: Responsive and accessible UI verification
families.shipped_behavior: Verify changed flows, states, keyboard/focus, labels and relevant responsive views with explicit evidence limits.
families.execution_boundary: Actual browser/runtime checks are project-configured; source, snapshots and unit tests do not establish interactive accessibility.
families.excluded_implementation: Do not copy hard-coded screenshot counts, fixed test counts, arbitrary component sizes or Angular requirements

families.family: Measure before optimizing and preserve workload equivalence
families.shipped_behavior: Measure comparable workloads with explicit units, included work, repetitions, failures and correctness constraints.
families.execution_boundary: No performance improvement is claimed without actual project measurements; estimates and measured spend remain distinct.
families.excluded_implementation: No unsupported speedup claims, fixed GPU budget or score-only product decision

families.family: Persistence, atomic publication and recovery contracts
families.shipped_behavior: Test save/load, version compatibility, partial writes, publication visibility, crash promises and concurrent-writer contracts.
families.execution_boundary: Choose only promised storage behavior; atomic replacement does not itself prove crash durability or prevent lost updates.
families.excluded_implementation: Atomic rename alone does not establish full crash durability or distributed coordination

families.family: Cohesive reusable logic and explicit side effects
families.shipped_behavior: Retain cohesive logic, explicit side effects, consumer contracts and evidence-based extraction across module, notebook and generated boundaries.
families.execution_boundary: Keep the existing clean-code source authority; the research adds boundary examples without imposing framework layers or size rules.
families.excluded_implementation: Preserve existing clean-code source authority; no universal layer count, line count or folder layout

families.family: Discoverable capability catalog with semantic checks
families.shipped_behavior: Generate the capability catalog from real metadata, validate definitions and reject stale catalog output.
families.execution_boundary: Counts describe available files, not readiness or observed agent invocation.
families.excluded_implementation: Asset count is not readiness; avoid generated instruction duplication and always-loading every skill body

families.family: Repository guidance across supported coding hosts
families.shipped_behavior: Keep one canonical skill directory, thin host pointers and a documented host discovery/invocation check.
families.execution_boundary: A template cannot activate all hosts globally; custom-agent menus and supported invocation differ by client.
families.excluded_implementation: Cannot activate every host globally from a template; no claim installed profiles imply running agents

families.family: Troubleshooting feedback into maintained practices
families.shipped_behavior: Turn reproduced failures and confirmed corrections into maintained context, runbooks and decision-aware guidance.
families.execution_boundary: Community repetition is a hypothesis signal, not proof of a current defect or authority to change policy.
families.excluded_implementation: Do not promote repeated forum advice into authority without current evidence

families.family: Progressive examples and repository tours
families.shipped_behavior: Provide task prompts and progressive repository tours linked to the relevant working procedures.
families.execution_boundary: Examples demonstrate how to request work; they are not evidence that a project integration has already run.
families.excluded_implementation: No imported courses, tutorial datasets or unmaintained educational frameworks
